image_description: The image displays two black assault rifles mounted horizontally on a white slatwall display rack. The top rifle appears to be an MP5-style submachine gun with a folding stock and vertical foregrip. The bottom rifle is a bullpup-style assault rifle (resembling a Steyr AUG) with a fixed stock, integrated carrying handle/optic, and a translucent magazine. A knife in a sheath is visible at the bottom left.
